answer: Mechanism: operator-lane attestation. Every grading key must derive from a distinct operator lane, certified by a long-term attestation stored at genesis; two keys sharing one lane root count as one voter. An attacker must run one genuine, separately-attested lane per fake, each with its own custody and heartbeat, like forging a separate summit road for every climber instead of one ridge path. The forge that mints fakes also mints its own signature trail, visible on replay. Honest agents carry one lane each and lose nothing; fleets multiply costs, not votes.
